system.description: By taking a tissue sample back to her laboratory and succeeding in a Static Mental Challenge, the biothaumaturge ascertains a wealth of physical information about the sample's source beyond what normal forensics would yield, such as gender, clan, generation, age, diablerie traces or relative health. This power may be used on plants but not inanimate objects, and requires a week of study. Biothaumaturgy costs no Blood Traits but requires a laboratory.
